description: This line plot illustrates the comparison of "Loss Ratio (%)" against "TFLOPs" for five different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "TFLOPs", utilizes a non-linear scale with specific discrete tick marks at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis, labeled "Loss Ratio (%)", employs a linear scale ranging from approximately 94 to 100.5, with major tick marks spaced at intervals of 1 unit from 95 to 100. The plot contains five solid lines distinguished by color and marker shape. The "Vanilla" configuration is represented by a purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, which remains constant at a value of exactly 100 across the entire x-axis. The "SepLLM (n=64)" configuration is shown as an orange line with plus markers; it begins at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to a peak of roughly 100.4 at 4e8, and ends at 100 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=128)" configuration is depicted by a dark blue line with cross markers, starting at 97.0 at 1e7, increasing to 99.8 at 2e8, and remaining relatively steady to finish at 99.8 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" configuration is a green line with diamond markers that starts at 97.5 at 1e7, reaches 100.0 at 2e8, peaks at 100.2 at 6e8, and concludes at 99.9 at 9e8. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configuration is illustrated by a red line with circle markers, beginning at the lowest point of approximately 94.0 at 1e7, rising to peak at 99.1 at 4e8, experiencing a dip to 98.4 at 5e8, and ending at 98.7 at 9e8.
